OR NTC/NAC passed in the trade of Mechanic Refrigeration & Air conditioner with three years experience in the relevant field. GI (Wireman): B.Voc/Degree in Electrical/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university with one year experience in the relevant field. OR 03 years Diploma in Electrical / Electrical and Electronics Engineering from AICTE recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT with two years experience in the relevant field. OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Wireman with three years' experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ITI Puri Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: GI (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Technician): B.Voc/Degree in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/university with one-year experience in the relevant field. OR 03 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT with two years' experience in the relevant field. OR NTC/NAC passed in the trade of Mechanic Refrigeration & Air conditioner with three years experience in the relevant field. GI (Wireman): B.Voc/Degree in Electrical/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university with one year experience in the relevant field. OR 03 years Diploma in Electrical / Electrical and Electronics Engineering from AICTE recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT with two years experience in the relevant field. OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Wireman with three years' experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ITI Puri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Instructor posts at Industrial Training Institute Puri is scheduled for 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well before the scheduled time.

faq.answer: As per the provided data, there are 0 vacancies for the Guest Instructor post. However, the detailed vacancy breakdown shows 1 post for GI (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Technician) and 1 post for GI (Wireman), totaling 2 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.answer: The job type for the Guest Instructor position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications include B.Voc/Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, and NTC/NAC in relevant trades like Mechanic Refrigeration & Air conditioner or Wireman, along with experience.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.
